newsitem.title: UK: Fayrewood rises to premium after placing.
newsitem.headline: Fayrewood rises to premium after placing.

text.p: Shares in acquisition vehicle Fayrewood Plc leapt to 20 percent premium on Thursday on their first day of dealings after a placing and open offer of shares at 45p.
The shares gained nine pence to 54p by 1030 GMT in volume that was estimated by dealers to be over 250,000 shares.

Fayrewood's shares were suspended from the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market on March 25 pending details on the proposed acquisition of Banque Magnetique, a computer and computer parts distribution company in France.
The company used the placing to raise 3.8 million stg before expenses in order to fund the acquisition and provide extra working capital.
Fayrewood is the holding company of Expotus Plc which distributes specialist profesional audio equipment to export markets.
